en.headline: Lantau Yacht Club Boat Show opens today as public part of Festival of Connoisseurs
en.dek: The free-admission event at Discovery Bay runs until 8 November with more than 30 yachts on display and marine technology booths, linked to the AsiaWorld-Expo luxury exhibition.
body: The Lantau Yacht Club Boat Show 2026 – Festa Nautica opens today at Lantau Yacht Club in Discovery Bay and runs until Sunday.

Organisers said the public event forms part of The Festival of Connoisseurs, the luxury living exhibition that has been under way at AsiaWorld-Expo since Wednesday. The boat show features more than 30 vessels in the marina, including a dedicated showcase of about 10 yachts from Zhuhai, along with marine technology displays.

Admission is free upon advance registration. Hours are 10am to 6pm daily. An opening ceremony is scheduled for this afternoon on the clubhouse lawn. Shuttle buses run from Discovery Bay Plaza and Auberge Discovery Bay.
The main Festival of Connoisseurs exhibition at AsiaWorld-Expo closes today, while the yacht show continues through the weekend as one of the public-facing elements of the programme.

zh.headline: 大嶼山遊艇會船展今日開幕 屬鑑賞家盛典公開部分
zh.dek: 愉景灣活動至8日免費入場（需預先登記），展出逾30艘遊艇及海事科技，並與亞洲國際博覽館奢華展覽相連。
body: 大嶼山遊艇會船展2026——Festa Nautica今日在愉景灣大嶼山遊艇會開幕，一連三日至星期日。
主辦單位表示，這是正在亞洲國際博覽館舉行的世界鑑賞家盛典（The Festival of Connoisseurs）公開部分之一。船展在碼頭展出逾30艘遊艇，包括約10艘珠海遊艇的專區，以及海事科技展示。
入場免費，惟需預先登記。每日開放時間為上午10時至下午6時。今天下午在會所草坪舉行開幕儀式。設有從愉景灣廣場及愉景灣酒店出發的接駁巴士。
亞洲國際博覽館的主展覽今日結束，而船展則繼續至周末，作為節目中面向公眾的環節。
